_readme: The time machine repair track for P0 (DECIDED 2026-09-28, Corey): three systems, three small steps each; all 9 are required before the machine can jump. Each step needs something from Rome (a membership, a finished project) or, for the first step of a system, more gold instead. No fuel puzzle, repair tiers or malfunctions (out of P0 scope). Amounts PROPOSED P0-21. To be built out later. Slowed down 2026-09-28 (Corey: the repair should take a couple of years): steps take 2–6 turns; with Attention shared across systems, the full track takes about 3–4 years. Optional upgrades (DECIDED 2026-09-28, Corey): not needed to jump; each lengthens the jump. The jump's distance depends on the repairs, your time in the era and the upgrades (tuning jump.range). Assessment (DECIDED 2026-09-28, Corey): before any repair or upgrade, one full assessment of the machine reveals what is wrong (1 Attention a turn for 4 turns). Gold (DECIDED 2026-09-28, Corey): the gold you scavenged from the machine at the start must all go back in before it can jump (tuning machine.restoreGold); the machine's gold is not debased, so the amount is fixed. Turn counts ×1.5 (rounded up) on 2026-09-28 with 2-month turns (Corey), so the repair still takes about 2.5 years.

assessment.name: Assess the machine
assessment.text: You strip the panels and trace every circuit by lamplight. Now you know what's wrong: the coil housing is cracked, the coolant has boiled away, and the chronometer has lost the date. (Machine: assessed; the repairs are known.)

steps.name: Source bronze for the coil housing
steps.altText: buy it at the open market instead
steps.text: Your trade contacts find you good bronze from the Campanian foundries.
steps.altDoneText: You pay open-market prices for bronze of uncertain quality, and it will do.

steps.name: Commission the casting at Ostia
steps.text: A founder at Ostia casts the housing to your drawing and asks no questions.

steps.name: Fit and test the coil housing
steps.text: The new housing seats cleanly; the coil hums when you close the circuit.

steps.name: Borrow glassware and a still
steps.altText: buy them from a glassblower instead
steps.text: The physicians lend you flasks, a still and a pair of tongs.
steps.altDoneText: A glassblower sells you flasks and a crude still at a stranger's price.

steps.name: Distil the coolant
steps.text: Three nights at the still give you a clear spirit, cold to the touch.

steps.name: Seal and test the coolant
steps.text: The coolant holds its seal; the gauge needle settles.

steps.name: Get into the state archives
steps.text: A senator's note gets you past the archive door.
steps.altDoneText: A clerk pockets your coins and lets you into the archives after dark.

steps.name: Copy the star tables
steps.text: You copy a season of star tables by lamplight, checking every column twice.

steps.name: Recalibrate the chronometer
steps.text: The chronometer's dial agrees with the stars to the hour.

upgrades.name: Gild the coil contacts
upgrades.altText: buy gold leaf from a jeweller instead
upgrades.text: Your trade contacts find gold leaf; the gilded contacts spark cleanly.
upgrades.altDoneText: A jeweller's gold leaf, dearly bought, and the contacts spark cleanly.

upgrades.name: Grind a sighting lens for the chronometer
upgrades.text: The physicians' glassblower grinds you a clear lens; the stars sit sharp in the sight.
upgrades.altDoneText: A glassblower grinds you a clear lens at a stranger's price; the stars sit sharp in the sight.

upgrades.name: Balance the flywheel
upgrades.altText: hire a smith by the day instead
upgrades.text: The smith trues the flywheel on his lathe until it spins without a tremor.
upgrades.altDoneText: A hired smith trues the flywheel until it spins without a tremor.
